Sandbox_GENZ_Scrappy_LootRadius_tooltip: Largest distance, in squares, between the dead zombie and Scrappy for it to take the jewelry off the corpse. Same floor only.
Sandbox_GENZ_Scrappy_AuraMultiplier_tool: Electricity and Metal Welding XP the owner earns near a working Scrappy. 1.0 turns the aura off. Does not stack with skill books: the larger one wins.
Sandbox_GENZ_Scrappy_WorkingThreshold_to: Below this condition Scrappy stops picking jewelry and giving the XP aura. At 0% it breaks and stays put until repaired.
Sandbox_GENZ_Scrappy_WearPerKill_tooltip: Condition Scrappy loses for every zombie it kills. 0 turns it off.
Sandbox_GENZ_Scrappy_WearPerDay_tooltip: Condition Scrappy loses per in-game day, even standing still. 0 turns it off.
Sandbox_GENZ_Scrappy_ChargeBattery_toolt: How much of Scrappy's charge a full battery restores. A half-used one gives half. 0 = batteries do not recharge it.
Sandbox_GENZ_Scrappy_ChargeCarBattery_to: How much of Scrappy's charge a full car battery restores. 0 = car batteries do not recharge it.
Sandbox_GENZ_Scrappy_ElectronicsGain_too: Condition each electronics scrap restores at Electricity level 0.
Sandbox_GENZ_Scrappy_ElectronicsGainPerL: Extra condition per Electricity level of the repairer.
Sandbox_GENZ_Scrappy_ElectronicsXP_toolt: XP per successful repair. The vanilla generator repair gives 5.
Sandbox_GENZ_Scrappy_ElectronicsLevel_to: Below this level the repair starts to fail (see the failure options).
Sandbox_GENZ_Scrappy_ScrapMetalGain_tool: Condition each scrap metal restores at Metal Welding level 0.
Sandbox_GENZ_Scrappy_ScrapMetalGainPerLe: Extra condition per Metal Welding level of the repairer.
Sandbox_GENZ_Scrappy_ScrapMetalLevel: Scrap metal: required Metal Welding level (default 3)
Sandbox_GENZ_Scrappy_ScrapMetalLevel_too: Below this level the repair starts to fail (see the failure options).
Sandbox_GENZ_Scrappy_CalibrateXP_tooltip: XP per successful calibration. Calibrating spends 1 electronics scrap and needs no wear.
Sandbox_GENZ_Scrappy_CalibratePerDay_too: How many calibrations each Scrappy takes per in-game day. 0 turns calibrating off.
Sandbox_GENZ_Scrappy_CalibrateLevel_tool: Below this level the calibration starts to fail (see the failure options).
Sandbox_GENZ_Scrappy_FailBase_tooltip: Chance to fail at exactly the required level. Same rule as the vanilla item repair.
Sandbox_GENZ_Scrappy_FailPerMissingLevel: Added per level below the required one. With the defaults: level 0 = 93%, 1 = 63%, 2 = 33%, 3 = 3%.
Sandbox_GENZ_Scrappy_FailPerExtraLevel_t: Taken off per level above the required one, down to 0%.
Sandbox_GENZ_Scrappy_FailedWear_tooltip: Condition Scrappy loses when a repair or calibration fails. The part is always lost and no XP is given.
Sandbox_GENZ_Scrappy_CycleTime_tooltip: Duration of each repair or calibration cycle at level 0, in game action units (the generator repair uses 150).
Sandbox_GENZ_Scrappy_CycleTimePerLevel_t: How much the cycle shortens per level of the skill used.
